assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
CPT 93247 is indicated for long-term continuous ECG monitoring study
The symptoms are intermittent in nature and require correlation with cardiac rhythm over an extended period
The study is indicated to evaluate for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
